# Alpenglow Software

> Alpenglow Software LLC makes small-business apps for Shopify and monday.com. Positioning: "Your back office, handled." The apps save time, filter out noise, and catch costly mistakes. They find, flag and recommend; the person using them makes the final call. Free and paid plans available.

Support: support@alpenglowsoftware.com. Privacy policies and terms for every app: https://legal.alpenglowsoftware.com/

## Save time (monday.com apps)

- [PostroomIQ](https://alpenglowsoftware.com/monday/postroomiq/): turns orders, invoices and leads forwarded to an email address, and their attachments, into monday.com board items with AI, and sends anything uncertain to review.
- [DedupeIQ](https://alpenglowsoftware.com/monday/dedupeiq/): finds duplicate items on monday.com boards by name, email, phone and company, and merges them only after you review each match; the duplicate is archived, not deleted.

## Filter the noise (Shopify apps)

- [ClearSignal](https://alpenglowsoftware.com/shopify/clearsignal/): sorts Shopify store sessions into real shoppers, good AI agents, bad bots and unclassified, and shows the conversion rate with bad bot and AI agent sessions taken out. It measures; it doesn't block visitors.
- [FraudPilot](https://alpenglowsoftware.com/shopify/fraudpilot/): puts the orders Shopify flags as medium or high risk in one review queue with the reasons, and keeps a log of your decisions. It never cancels orders or blocks checkouts.

## Catch costly mistakes (Shopify apps)

- [TaxDelta](https://alpenglowsoftware.com/shopify/taxdelta/): reads Shopify orders and flags sales tax to check before you file, such as tax over-refunded on partial refunds and tax collected in states you aren't registered in. It only reads orders and doesn't file returns.
- [GhostCode](https://alpenglowsoftware.com/shopify/ghostcode/): audits a Shopify theme for the apps that slow it, known malicious scripts, wrong schema prices, script tag apps and leftover app code from apps that may no longer be installed. It only reads the theme and never edits it.
